prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1009; do not mention it.)
text:
Our firm represents the individual injured in a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. The other vehicle struck our client's car, and our client has sustained injuries that are being evaluated and treated. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information in writing as soon as possible.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and the vehicle itself where it remains in your possession. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained. We look forward to your prompt response.
